Helix man.fact: An unnamed man (Helix representative) left the ward without obtaining what he came for.

Ambrosia.fact: Ambrosia received a contract at 02:11 — while the Helix man was still present — containing a patient symptom profile she recognized with disturbing familiarity.
Ambrosia found that the referring physician Dr. Cassius Vael does not exist in any of four licensed physician databases she checked.
Ambrosia documented all discrepancies meticulously and then accepted the contract anyway.
Ambrosia arrived at Orsolya's shop in the Hamtramck Enclave in the early hours of the morning.
Orsolya read Ambrosia's recent fear and exhaustion from her physical bearing and the state of her coat without being told anything.
Orsolya identified Ambrosia as the person Dariusz called about, assessed her instrument case, and instructed her to sit so she could examine it.
Orsolya repairs Ambrosia's instrument case and charges her forty Quanta without asking what it is for.
Ambrosia boards the I-90 Vein maglev at 04:30 and travels ninety minutes toward the Ferrogate corridor.
Ambrosia arrives at the decommissioned relay station and meets Milo.

Milo tells Ambrosia his name, describes his symptoms — pressure behind his left ear, inaccessible information, false memories — and recounts receiving a clean bill of health from a Ferrogate contractor clinic eight months ago.
Ambrosia's instruments confirm a dormant secondary neural interface in Milo, architecturally identical to a ghost implant she has been concealing in her records for three months.
Ambrosia chooses to document the secondary interface in her private discrepancy file rather than report it through official channels, and notes that Milo is unaware of the implant.
